student.name: Aarav Sharma
student.bio: A motivated computer science student with a strong interest in cloud computing, machine learning, and open-source software. Actively building expertise through certifications, hackathons, and research collaborations.

achievements.title: AWS Certified Cloud Practitioner
achievements.description: Validated foundational knowledge of cloud concepts, AWS services, security, architecture, pricing, and support. Completed 4 months of self-study and 2 practice exams.

achievements.title: National Hackathon 2026 – Runner Up
achievements.description: Achieved runner-up position out of 600+ participants. Built EcoVision — an AI-powered waste classification system using computer vision and TensorFlow Lite deployed on edge devices.

achievements.title: Google Data Analytics Certificate
achievements.description: Completed the 8-course Google Data Analytics professional certificate covering data cleaning, analysis, visualisation, and case studies.

achievements.title: Open Source Contributor Award
achievements.description: Recognised for consistent contributions to the OpenDev India community: merged 24 pull requests, reviewed 40+ issues, and maintained a popular utility library.

achievements.title: Student Leadership Workshop
achievements.description: Completed a 2-day intensive leadership and professional development workshop covering team dynamics, conflict resolution, and strategic thinking.

projects.title: EcoVision – AI Waste Classification System
projects.description: Edge-deployed computer vision pipeline that classifies municipal recyclable vs. organic waste in real time with 94.2% validation accuracy. Built and presented at the National Hackathon 2026.

projects.title: CloudCost Sentinel
projects.description: Serverless AWS monitoring toolkit that continuously inspects underutilized EC2 and RDS instances, computes projected monthly savings, and publishes automated digest alerts to Slack.

projects.title: OpenDev Utility Toolkit
projects.description: Modular TypeScript runtime utilities library maintained under OpenDev India. Contributed 24 merged PRs, comprehensive test coverage (98%), and automated npm publish workflows.

publicPortfolio.customHeadline: B.Tech in Computer Science · Aspiring Cloud & ML Engineer

feedback.subject: Your recent AWS certification and next steps
feedback.message: Congratulations on earning the AWS Cloud Practitioner certificate, Aarav! This is a great step. I strongly recommend pursuing the Solutions Architect Associate as your next milestone – it will complement your machine learning interests well. Also, consider contributing to AWS open-source projects on GitHub to strengthen your practical portfolio.
actionItems: Contribute to one AWS open-source project

feedback.subject: Research paper progress check-in
feedback.message: Good progress on the literature review, Aarav. The section on transformer models is particularly well-written. I’d like you to also explore the efficiency benchmarks from the 2025 NeurIPS papers – they are very relevant to our thesis direction. Let's schedule a meeting next week to finalise the research scope.

feedback.subject: Internship application strategy
feedback.message: Your profile is shaping up nicely. For the summer 2027 internship cycle, I recommend targeting 20–25 companies across 3 tiers: 5 reach companies (Google, Microsoft, Amazon), 10 core targets (mid-tier product companies), and 8 safety picks. Your current GPA and certifications make you competitive. Let's refine your resume to emphasise quantified impact from your hackathon and open-source work.
